udt_struct_v0.doc: One primed leveraged-open callback, staged by the Blend borrow venue immediately before\n`account.flash_open` and consumed (take-and-clear) by the pool's `exec_op` callback.
udt_struct_v0.name: PendingOp

fields.doc: The borrow account whose flash loan this is (`exec_op`'s expected `caller`).
fields.name: account

fields.doc: The swap aggregator to sell the stake through.
fields.name: aggregator

fields.doc: Debt amount kept back and forwarded to `margin_to` as total IRS margin.
fields.name: irs_margin_amount

fields.doc: The exact flash-loan amount expected (`exec_op`'s expected `amount`).
fields.name: loan_amount

fields.doc: The broker (lock-borrow) \xe2\x80\x94 receives `irs_margin_amount`.
fields.name: margin_to

fields.doc: Slippage floor: the swap must deliver at least this much collateral.
fields.name: min_collateral_out

fields.doc: Debt amount to convert into collateral (loan + any debt-side deposit \xe2\x88\x92 IRS margin).
fields.name: stake

fields.doc: The aggregator route, as `StrategyPayload` XDR. Built off-chain, where the quote comes\nfrom; `min_collateral_out` below is what makes accepting it safe.
fields.name: swap_xdr

cases.doc: `prime` while another op is already pending.
cases.name: OpAlreadyPending

cases.doc: `exec_op` with no primed op, or with a caller/token/amount not matching it.
cases.name: FlashCallbackUnauthorized

function_v0.doc: The pool's flash callback: take-and-clear the primed op, verify the callback is the\none primed (the `pendingFlashLoan` guard), convert the staked debt into collateral\nfor the account, and forward the held-back IRS margin to the broker.
function_v0.name: exec_op

function_v0.doc: Replace the contract's wasm. The owner is the Blend borrow venue, whose admin reaches this\nentrypoint through `upgrade_flash_receiver`; the receiver address and storage are kept.
function_v0.name: upgrade

udt_struct_v0.doc: A single pool operation submitted via `BlendPool::submit`.
udt_struct_v0.name: Request

fields.doc: The reserve's underlying asset address (for Supply/Withdraw/Borrow/Repay).
fields.name: address

fields.doc: Token amount (in the underlying's native units).
fields.name: amount

fields.doc: Discriminant \xe2\x80\x94 use the `REQUEST_*` constants below.
fields.name: request_type

udt_struct_v0.doc: A fully-decoded reserve (config + live data), returned by `get_reserve`.
udt_struct_v0.name: Reserve

udt_struct_v0.doc: Arguments for `BlendPool::flash_loan`: the loan is minted as dTokens on `from`, `amount`\nof `asset` is transferred to `contract`, and `contract.exec_op(from, asset, amount, 0)`\nruns before the declared requests are pulled back from `from` via allowance.
udt_struct_v0.name: FlashLoan

fields.doc: Loan amount (in the underlying's native units).
fields.name: amount

fields.doc: The reserve underlying being flash-borrowed.
fields.name: asset

fields.doc: The moderc3156 receiver invoked as `exec_op(caller, token, amount, fee)`.
fields.name: contract

udt_struct_v0.doc: A user's open positions in the pool, indexed by reserve index (`config.index`).\nA non-collateral supply credits bTokens in the `supply` map.
udt_struct_v0.name: Positions

fields.doc: Reserve index \xe2\x86\x92 bToken balance (collateral supply shares).
fields.name: collateral

fields.doc: Reserve index \xe2\x86\x92 dToken balance (borrowed shares).
fields.name: liabilities

fields.doc: Reserve index \xe2\x86\x92 bToken balance (non-collateral supply shares).
fields.name: supply

udt_struct_v0.doc: Pool-level configuration, returned by `get_config`. Consumed for `oracle` (the SEP-40\nprice source health-factor math reads) and `status`.
udt_struct_v0.name: PoolConfig

fields.doc: Backstop take rate on accrued debt interest, 7 decimals.
fields.name: bstop_rate

fields.doc: Max effective positions a single user can hold.
fields.name: max_positions

fields.doc: Minimum collateral (in oracle base units) required to open a liability position.
fields.name: min_collateral

fields.doc: The pool's price oracle contract.
fields.name: oracle

fields.doc: Pool status (0/1 active, odd values are backstop-triggered; see Blend docs).
fields.name: status

udt_struct_v0.doc: Per-reserve runtime data \xe2\x80\x94 updated on every interest accrual.
udt_struct_v0.name: ReserveData

fields.doc: bToken (supply share) exchange-rate index, **12 decimals** (`SCALAR_12`).\n`underlying = b_tokens * b_rate / SCALAR_12`.
fields.name: b_rate

fields.doc: Total outstanding bToken supply.
fields.name: b_supply

fields.doc: Underlying owed to the backstop (accumulated interest).
fields.name: backstop_credit

fields.doc: dToken (borrow share) exchange-rate index, 12 decimals.
fields.name: d_rate

fields.doc: Total outstanding dToken supply.
fields.name: d_supply

fields.doc: Interest-rate modifier (7 decimals).
fields.name: ir_mod

fields.doc: Last ledger timestamp at which interest was accrued.
fields.name: last_time

udt_union_v0.doc: SEP-40 asset key: a Stellar token, or a ticker symbol.
udt_union_v0.name: Asset

udt_struct_v0.doc: SEP-40 price record: `price` in the oracle's `decimals`, quoted in its base asset.
udt_struct_v0.name: PriceData

udt_struct_v0.doc:
One swap hop through a specific pool.

`amount_out` is ignored by the aggregator \xe2\x80\x94 it derives the honorable output from live reserves \xe2\x80\x94
so a payload built on-chain can leave it at `0`.
udt_struct_v0.name: SwapHop

udt_struct_v0.doc: One sub-route: a sequence of hops taking `split_ppm` (parts-per-million) of the total input.
udt_struct_v0.name: SwapPath

udt_union_v0.doc: A DEX the aggregator can route a hop through. Mirrors the Router's own `SwapVenue`.
udt_union_v0.name: SwapVenue

udt_struct_v0.doc:
The full route. `total_min_out` is the only slippage bound the aggregator itself enforces.

Field names and types mirror the Router's ABI **exactly** \xe2\x80\x94 the payload crosses the boundary as
XDR ([`soroban_sdk::xdr::ToXdr`]), so a renamed or reordered field does not fail to compile, it
fails to decode on the other side.
udt_struct_v0.name: StrategyPayload
